summary: Noise gate and downward expander, the successor of Pedal Gate: a threshold with a separate, lower close threshold (hysteresis), attack, hold and release (linear gain ramps, as Pedal Gate's), a Range floor, an expansion ratio (infinity is a hard gate, lower ratios expand downwards), Peak or RMS detection, a key filter (low and high cut), an external sidechain on input 2, lookahead and Listen to the key. Delta (hear only what the gate takes out) and a gain-match reading. Use it to clean spill from drum tracks, tighten a bass or cut the noise between phrases.
use_for: Clean up noise, bleed and tails with a gate or downward expander, optionally keyed from a sidechain.

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.description: The level that opens the gate

parameters.name: Hysteresis
parameters.description: The gate closes this far under the threshold: more means less chatter

parameters.name: Ratio
parameters.description: Expansion below the close threshold: every dB under it is (ratio − 1) dB quieter, down to Range. Infinity: a hard gate that goes straight to Range

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The closed gate's gain floor: -90 dB nearly shut, 0 dB no gating

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Time for the gain to open fully (a linear ramp)

parameters.name: Hold
parameters.description: How long the gate stays open after the signal falls under the close threshold

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Time for the gain to close fully (a linear ramp)

parameters.name: Lookahead
parameters.description: Delays the audio so the gate opens before the transient arrives (latency)

parameters.name: Detection
parameters.description: Peak: fast, follows transients. RMS: 10 ms average, smoother on sustained sources

parameters.name: Sidechain
parameters.description: Detect from the input, or from input 2 (connect a machine to the second input)

parameters.name: Key low cut
parameters.description: High-pass on the key: keeps low rumble from opening the gate (off at its minimum)

parameters.name: Key high cut
parameters.description: Low-pass on the key: keeps hiss and cymbals from opening the gate (off at its maximum)

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Gain after the gate, 0.1 dB steps (the editor's Match sets it from the gain-match reading)

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: Hear only what the gate takes out: the output minus the input, delayed to match (glides over 10 ms)

readings.description: The gate's gain now, dB (0 open, down to Range when closed)
1 while the gate is open, 0 while it is closed or closing
The lookahead, reported to NeoBuzz Live
